name: prunplanner
description: Plan with PRUNplanner from your AI assistant: read and calculate plans and empires, and save plans, empires and CX preferences.
long_description: Lists your empires and plans, calculates plans and empires, tries plan variants, checks plans against the market, looks up prices, planets and materials. With a read-write API key it also saves plans (every save is a version you can restore), creates and changes empires and CX preferences, shares plans and sets your planning defaults; deleting asks first. A read-only key only reads. Needs a PRUNplanner API key (prunplanner.org/apikey).
